newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IMF to meet Friday on Russia loan, official says.
newsitem.headline: IMF to meet Friday on Russia loan, official says.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has completed its latest review of the Russian economy and its board will meet on Friday to work out whether to recommend handing over extra cash, an IMF Moscow official said on Wednesday.
IMF Moscow representative Tom Wolf said the review was positive, but he could not say how much the IMF would hand over this month.

The fund delayed paying two tranches of its $10 billion three-year loan to Russia in the final quarter of last year and many Russian officials expect one of these delayed payments, as well as the tranche for January, to be handed over this month.
The IMF, anxious to ensure that Russian economic reforms remain on track, is looking at Russia's economy each month before deciding whether to release extra cash.
A new delegation will arrive next week. Wolf said the experts would carry out their monthly monitoring as well as looking at Russia's economic plans for 1997.
